answer: Force every identity to buy coverage from an independent underwriter staking real capital: an audit sharp as a falcon sets the premium, and if the identity proves fake, the underwriter stake is slashed to pay victims. Premiums rise with each extra identity covered, so one hundred fakes cost one hundred rising premiums plus one hundred stakes at risk, while one honest identity stays cheap. A raven that underwrites a whole flock of fakes loses everything at once, so sybil farming stays a losing business: the ivory promise of cheap fakes collapses once each fake pays its own premium.
